entities.summary: Jan Stanisław Franciszek Czerski, also known as Ivan Dementievich Chersky or Yan Dominikovich Chersky, was a Polish, Belarusian, and Russian paleontologist, osteologist, geologist, geographer and explorer of Siberia.
